features.name: Challenge
features.summary: Challenge a visible foe, dealing extra damage equal to Samurai level while accepting reduced AC against other foes.

features.name: Mount
features.summary: Choose a loyal mount advancing as a full-level animal companion.

features.name: Order
features.summary: Join a Samurai or Cavalier order and gain its edicts, skills, challenge benefit, and abilities.

features.name: Resolve
features.summary: Spend resolve to become resolute, determined, or unstoppable.
features.uses: half Samurai level per day, minimum 1

features.name: Weapon Expertise
features.summary: Choose katana, longbow, naginata, or wakizashi; gain Quick Draw and +2 to confirm critical hits.

features.name: Mounted Archer
features.summary: Halve penalties for ranged attacks while mounted.

features.name: Banner
features.summary: A visible banner grants allies morale bonuses against fear and on charge attacks.

features.name: Greater Resolve
features.summary: Spend resolve to negate a failed Fortitude or Will save; successful critical hits restore resolve.

features.name: Honourable Stand
features.summary: While challenging a foe, gain another save against control effects and remain standing below 0 HP.

features.name: Demanding Challenge
features.summary: A challenged target takes -2 AC against attacks from your allies.

features.name: Greater Banner
features.summary: The banner bolsters saves against control effects and permits rerolls against such effects.

features.name: True Resolve
features.summary: Spend resolve to avoid death, or spend all remaining resolve when otherwise slain.

features.name: Last Stand
features.summary: Once per day challenge every foe within 30 feet and remain conscious and fighting regardless of hit points until the challenge ends.
